verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is API-first: full REST API, five official SDKs, and manageable API keys (with expiry/rotation) all support running the product programmatically/headlessly outside a UI, which is the core requirement for CI-style automation. However, there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, pipeline examples, or automation-specific guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions, scheduled batch jobs) confirming this use case is officially supported. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs or examples, confirmation of non-interactive auth flows suited to CI (e.g., service accounts), independent verification of headless automation in production.
